items.title: Epoch AI updates its AI data centers database (96 sites tracked)
items.summary_en: According to a search-engine snippet of Epoch's data hub, the database now covers 96 sites, about 15.2M H100-equivalents and 14.5 GW of IT power. Epoch estimates this is roughly 44% of global deployed AI computing capacity. The largest tracked site is reported as the Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle campus at about 1,037 MW.
items.source_name: Epoch AI Data on AI Data Centers
items.notes: epoch.ai blocked; figures and date from a search summary. Verify before publishing.

items.title: Epoch AI releases an AI Chip Imports explorer
items.summary_en: A search summary says the explorer, released on Oct 27, estimates the US has received about 72% of AI compute imported since 2022, against roughly 10% for China. These are Epoch's own estimates and likely carry uncertainty.
items.notes: Index URL used; exact explorer URL not seen. Unverified.
